overview_description.description:
Scout is a home security system that combines hardware designs and easy-to-use controls. It enables its users to access the device from anywhere on their phones, tablets, or computers.

The company's monitoring technology gives its users peace of mind at home and away. It also allows its users to customize their responses to all alerts.


Scout was founded in 2012 in Chicago, Illinois.

about_short_description.short_description: Scout Security is a home security system that combines hardware designs and easy-to-use controls.

product.name: Scout Hub
product.description: The central unit that connects to the internet router and wirelessly communicates with all Scout sensors and the mobile app.

product.name: Door Panel
product.description: A device that monitors entryways, allows arming/disarming the system, and includes a siren and RFID scanner.

product.name: Access Sensor
product.description: Sensors that monitor the opening and closing of doors, windows, cabinets, or drawers to secure the perimeter or interior of a home.

product.name: Motion Sensor
product.description: A sensor that detects movement up to 25 feet away with a 90-degree field of view, usable day or night.

product.name: Scout HD Camera
product.description: A 1080p high-definition camera providing live video feed and recorded clips accessible via the Scout app.

product.name: Water Sensor
product.description: A sensor that detects the presence of water to alert users to potential leaks or flooding.
